notes.title: ESDigital Games Reveals Exciting Gamescom Line-up!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to reveal our 2024 Gamescom lineup, with some stellar titles showcasing never-before-seen gameplay in both the Business and Consumer halls at this year’s event!

[previewyoutube=LlQ6vq4RCJ4;full][/previewyoutube]

Gamers heading to Gamescom will have the chance to get hands-on with some truly exciting titles covering all kinds of genres! Located in the bustling Indie Arena Booth (Hall 10.2, Booth F010g - E019) we will be showcasing brand new game demos for AWAKEN - Astral Blade, Steel Seed, Island of Winds, BattleJuice Alchemist and Sky of Tides.

There will also be the chance to snap a picture with two awesome cosplayers portraying the protagonists Tania from AWAKEN - Astral Blade and Zoe from Steel Seed as well as grabbing some cool branded merchandise after trying out the hands-on demos.

In addition to the Indie Arena Booth, our team will also have playable demos for Cats on Duty, Memory Lost, and REMEDIUM on the Polish Indie Booth (Hall 10.2, F-041) for fans to try out! 

More information on the great games available to play at Gamescom:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/458430/Steel_Seed/

Steel Seed (Storm in Teacup Studio) is a single player stealth-action adventure game set in a dark sci-fi world. In her epic journey inside a hostile underground facility run by AIs, Zoe is alone with Koby, a flying drone, as her only companion. Use Zoe's parkour skills to traverse the underground facility and gain a tactical advantage. Don't forget about stealth-based techniques to explore the facility's hostile environment undetected by robotic entities and guards. Some confrontations can be avoided through efficient movement. Also, get acquainted with KOBY, because he is the master key of Steel Seed and Zoe's guide on her lonely and dangerous journey inside the underground facility. By working together, they create a formidable duo and bring something new to every fight.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1689340/Island_of_Winds/

Island of Winds (Parity Games Studio) is an adventure game set in a fantastical world inspired by 17th century Iceland and its folklore. Experience the story of Brynhildur, a Balance Keeper who embarks on a journey of self-discovery. Core gameplay involves intriguing puzzles, spellcasting, and a focus on empathy encounters. The core gameplay involves spellcasting, intriguing puzzles, fantastical lore, and a special focus on approaching encounters with empathy. Island of Winds features a semi-open world environment that explores themes of self-doubt, violence, regret and empathy, as well as the conservation of nature.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1716310/AWAKEN__Astral_Blade/

AWAKEN - Astral Blade (Dark Pigeon Games). Weave your own story in this dark fairy tale 2D action-platformer metroidvania. In the mysterious ancient ruins, you will adventure with Tania to reveal her origins and fate. Is there any chance of survival in the darkest and desperate place? Slain your foes with a wide range of combos: from fastest to slowest. Parry enemy attacks to gain an advantage, use Fast Stand Up ability to get back into the fight and dash into enemies while they're attacking to slow the world around you and gain damage immunity. Combos and Skills will also help you to break through hordes of enemies and defeat bosses. Control the course of the story, help Tania make choices at the crucial moments of the game and take your own path to reveal mysteries of the past and present. Different routes may lead you to different endings. Search the Horace Islands for clues and information about mysterious and dangerous world of the AWAKEN - Astral Blade.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1120330/Sky_of_Tides/

Sky of Tides (Lofty Sky Entertainment Studio) is a sci-fi narrative game set in a technologically advanced universe on the brink of war. Play as Rin, who must search for her missing father and heal the broken planet of Numen. Explore the world while your choices shape your character.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1384060/BattleJuice_Alchemist/

BattleJuice Alchemist (Alchemical Works Studio) is a complex alchemy RPG that adds a unique item and skill system to the classic aRPG formula. Focus on isometric combat or opt for JRPG-style one-on-one fights. Explore the wilderness, learn ritual magic, build a tower and craft potions to fight the demonic hordes of Samhain. Juice, the alchemist, is called to Caribou Creek to fight the demons that roam the lands. As your unique version of Juice you explore the wilderness that once was New England. Fight evil in classic action RPG isometric top down view and in bullet-time close combat. Find and craft items with game-changing powers. Master BattleJuice Alchemist's deck-building mechanics by arranging your compilation of flasks to suit your playstyle. Accentuate your character beyond character customization by using ritual magic as long-term buffs. Meet strange creatures from the Crossroads while the dark plot of BattleJuice Alchemist unravels.

Additionally, there are opportunities for hands-on with these titles:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1659090/REMEDIUM/

REMEDIUM is a fast-paced twin-stick shooter set in a grim post-apocalyptic Renaissance setting. A special build for journalists, with all acts available + some never before seen new acts.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2447260/Cats_on_Duty/

Cats on Duty is a purr-fect blend of match-3 and real time strategy with tower defense mechanics. The full build of the Deluxe Edition will be available.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1483190/Memory_Lost/

Memory Lost is a story-driven cyberpunk twin-stick action shooter where players will have to capture the minds and bodies of their enemies to survive during combat.

Plus, if you feel like talking to the devs, we have good news for you! You can meet the lead developers from "Storm in TeaCup", "Parity Games", "Lofty Sky Entertainment", "Sobaka Studio" and "Alchemical Works" at our booths at Gamescom!

Our team is looking forward to welcoming all gamers to the Indie Arena Booth from 21-25 August, so head over to Hall 10.2, say hi and play some awesome games!

notes.title: BattleJuice Alchemist transmutes into action!
notes.content:
ESDigital Games and Alchemical Works are delighted to reveal their action adventure RPG title BattleJuice Alchemist and its new announcement trailer!

[previewyoutube=_JlygN27g1Q;full][/previewyoutube]

BattleJuice Alchemist is a complex alchemy RPG that adds an equipment-based skill system to the classic aRPG formula. Focus on top-down combat or opt for JRPG-style one-on-one fights. Explore the wilderness, learn ritual magic, and craft potions to fight demonic hordes overrunning the lands.

Juice, the alchemist, is called to Caribou Creek to fight the demons that roam the lands. As your unique version of Juice, you explore the wilderness that once was New England. Fight evil in classic action RPG isometric top-down view and in bullet-time close combat.

Find and craft items with game-changing powers. Master BattleJuice Alchemist’s deck-building mechanics by arranging your compilation of flasks to suit your playstyle. Accentuate your character beyond character customization by using ritual magic as long-term buffs. Meet strange creatures from the Crossroads while the dark plot of BattleJuice Alchemist unravels.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38469214/3a29e0c41079d009f23b3a23afabdb7c86aa9d70.jpg

UNIQUE ITEMS AND CHARACTER BUILDS
Loot and Craft: As an alchemist you wear no armor and wield no sword, but you rain down fire on your enemies. Find flasks with unique properties in the wilderness or craft them at your workbench. In deck-building fashion you create a compilation of flasks which you randomly draw from.

Unique Skill System: In BattleJuice Alchemist, your flasks are your skills. Every flask can be used the normal way and at times in a supercharged, "jucified" way for stronger effects. Some flasks have powers attached to them that drastically change their effects when used, which allows you to develop your own playstyle.

EXPLORE A DARK WORLD
Procedural Landscapes, Hand-crafted Towns: The world of BattleJuice Alchemist is separated into vast levels of procedural landscape. Every valley, sea, river, mountain, building, stone, tree and item is placed by a unique algorithm. This allows you to continue exploring after you completed the main story. Quest locations are still hand-crafted to tell compelling stories.

Dark Lands to Discover: You are influenced by daytime and weather effects and so are your enemies. But they are also buffed by the evermore spawning demons’ presence. Find dark altars to hold their influence at bay and discover many other secrets.

ENGAGING COMBAT
Classic isometric ARPG action: Fight your enemies from afar in classic top down view. Throw explosive or freezing flasks at them, prepare ambushes of explosive barrels. Use the “Frog Hop” flask to jump away from danger or right into close combat.

Close Combat with Bullet-time: Enter close combat with an enemy, where you can interact hands on by dodging or using smoke flasks to avoid being hit. Manage your resources and flasks during these intense one on one battles against your awe-inspiring enemies from the Crossroads.

notes.title: Update v.1.20.04
notes.content:
GREAT news for fans of REMEDIUM: Sentinels! The game has just received a long-awaited and crucial update that players have been eagerly anticipating. The highlight of this update is the introduction of the "Dash" feature, a highly requested addition that promises to revolutionize gameplay!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43428411/118890eb19c21b474f0e56492c037df1b7923515.gif

The "Dash" feature can be activated by pressing Shift or X, allowing players to perform lightning-fast dashes, enhancing mobility, and opening up new strategic possibilities. This addition not only accelerates the pace of the game but also adds depth to the gameplay.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43428411/e07c10371c83a3426df3fad2fdf3e2102d1ea622.jpg

In addition to the "Dash" feature, the game has migrated to Unreal Engine 5.3. While this change may not be immediately noticeable, it sets the stage for future improvements and optimizations.

One notable adjustment is the rebalancing of the difficulty in Berserk Mode, making it even more challenging for players seeking an adrenaline-fueled experience. To accommodate this increased difficulty, score points have been doubled, rewarding players who dare to take on the heightened challenges.

Furthermore, we have plans to expand and refine the "Dash" feature for different Sentinels, each with its own unique abilities and characteristics, promising even more diverse and engaging gameplay in the future.

The "Dash" update is a significant step forward for REMEDIUM: Sentinels, and players can look forward to an enhanced gaming experience filled with speed, strategy, and excitement. Dive into the action now and discover the game's newfound intensity!

notes.title: Update v.1.20.03
notes.content:
Greetings, Sentinels!

The game received a small technical update, in which:


 We have implemented a backup system for sending the points scored by the player to the leaderboards. Some of the players reported that their score was not included in the rating, so we double-checked the system for calculating and sending results, and also added an internal parameter for controlling and duplicating sending statistics. Now your record score will not be lost and will definitely get to the leaderboard!

 A dynamic resolution system has been added to the game. Its goal is to minimize the load on the system even on weak computers. Now the game, seeing that the hardware is starting to run out of resources, lowers the resolution with minimal loss in image quality and thereby frees up additional resources. A very useful thing for the endless mode!

 In connection with the previous paragraph and as part of the overall optimization of the game, some special effects have been improved. Visually, the game hasn't changed much, but it works more smoothly!

 Fixed a typo with "Contols". Nobody saw anything ᕕ( ᐛ )ᕗ


You can discuss the changes in the comments or in the official Discord. Let's talk!

notes.title: Update v.1.19.02
notes.content:
Hey Sentinels! 

We've done it as quickly as possible, and it's here! REMEDIUM: Sentinels received a content update and a post-release hotfix. In the game, you'll now find peasants trapped in cages on some maps, and your mission is to save them from the mutants. We've also introduced storage areas with canisters. Yes, the canisters are separate from the storage areas. The pesky mutants have scattered green liquid in alchemical containers all over the map, and now you have to collect it back to earn extra points!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43428411/3859c9418cf373029654f4fc73a4eb3e0caa7f2a.jpg

After the release, some enemies were oddly shimmering with rainbow colors. Most likely, it was due to the fuel from the canisters, but don't worry, we've fixed it, and nothing stands in the way of immersing yourself in the grim "unrainbowy" atmosphere! *evil laughter*

We closed off the locations! Well, not really "closed off" per se, they were meant to be discovered one by one, so you could explore them properly. But in the excitement after the release, all maps magically unlocked for everyone. We celebrated and had enough fun; now it's time to get to work and protect humanity from the mutants!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43428411/c623e637683565fd1db22c2b3f241e574d4e0d8c.jpg

Oh, and before the release, there was a screen resolution limitation, but now you can enjoy playing in full 4K! You asked for it - we've done it. We closely monitor all the feedback and make all the necessary changes to make the gameplay even more engaging!

And don't forget, REMEDIUM: Sentinels is currently available with a 20% release discount. Grab it while it lasts!

notes.title: Update v.0.17.01
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Today's update has brought a multitude of small but pleasant and useful changes to the game, both in terms of visuals and gameplay, primarily focusing on balancing various aspects of the game.


 Sound Effects Quality and Quantity Improvements: We have enhanced the quality and quantity of sound effects in the game. There are now fewer silent moments, and in some areas, the audio accompaniment has been improved.
 Localization Fixes: We have addressed errors in some texts for better localization.
 Weapon Balancing: Weapons have undergone significant optimization! To maintain balance, the power of certain weapon types has been reduced, while others have been increased.
 Main Menu Button Icons: We have added icons to the buttons in the main menu for improved convenience and usability.
 Experience Bar and Timer Visuals: The appearance of the experience bar and timer has been changed.
 Leaderboards: A score counter has been added, now displayed in the rush mode! In upcoming updates, we will continue to enhance this feature.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43428411/5ef6d93d138416d2b23674703c8440d22109d014.jpg
 Session Modifiers: Before a battle, you can now choose one of five modifiers: four elemental modifiers (enhancing elemental damage) and one universal modifier (increasing any type of damage).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43428411/af4e24daecbd259ad7b57399913ade3d8e6e2c58.jpg
 Balanced Endless Battle Mode: This has significantly increased the average gameplay time! Previously, the average player could survive for about two minutes, but now that time has increased nearly tenfold!

We are continuously evolving the game! Since its release in early access, it has seen significant content growth, and most importantly, the game is constantly being fine-tuned in preparation for its full release!

notes.title: Update v.0.16.01
notes.content:
BIG news everyone!
Remedium Sentinels has just received a BIG update, bringing a wave of thrilling features and gameplay improvements. Prepare to dive deeper into the world of golems and face exciting challenges with these exciting additions. Let's take a closer look!

Expanded Bestiary:
The in-game Bestiary has undergone a comprehensive update, providing players with even more detailed information about the captivating creatures that inhabit this fantastical realm. Study their strengths and weaknesses to gain a strategic edge in your battles.

New Weapons:
Introducing two powerful new weapons: Decoy and Chain. With the Decoy, players can now manipulate enemy attention, opening up new tactical possibilities. The Chain weapon offers a devastating melee option, empowering players to unleash chaos upon their adversaries.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43428411/19a31be5f5c5b1150f33fd93a1ad7ccd8c185d81.jpg

Unique Weapons for Golems:
The Percussor and Saw blades have been transformed into unique weapons exclusive to their respective golems. Each golem now possesses a specialized arsenal, reflecting their distinctive playstyles and strengths. Master these new weapons to unleash the true potential of your golem.

Balancing and Difficulty:
To ensure a captivating gameplay experience, the experience and difficulty levels have been meticulously rebalanced. Brace yourself for a well-tuned challenge that caters to both seasoned veterans and newcomers. Prepare for intense battles that will push your skills to the limit.

Level Difficulty Icons:
We've added intuitive difficulty icons to each level, providing players with a clearer understanding of the challenges that lie ahead. Choose your path wisely and conquer the increasingly demanding encounters.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43428411/cfdc4c8dcf880c589acb0876e6c761d950fe5942.png

Enhanced Golem Statistics:
Delve into the mechanics of your golems with the newly added stat feature. Monitor crucial attributes such as strength, speed, and resilience to optimize your golem's performance and dominate the battlefield.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43428411/1654ee1189c10ad308603a1730144c459e3ce083.png

In response to player feedback, the upgrade screen has been streamlined for a smoother experience. When an upgrade option is unavailable, players will now receive gold instead of being presented with inaccessible menus. Use this gold to further empower your golems and expand your arsenal.

notes.title: AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.content:
Roguelite fast-paced auto-shooter REMEDIUM: Sentinels is now available in Early Access!

The game is set in the same world as REMEDIUM game. It has been more than a hundred years since the Grey Plague has won turning most humans into vicious mutant freaks, and only a handful of cities still stand amidst the death and chaos that consumed the land.

Now you can take control of a Sentinel created by alchemists with only one goal - defend the cities against the endless hordes of mutants until your reactor dies. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2244480/REMEDIUM_Sentinels/

Combine items and alchemical elements to acquire more and more weapons and create unique builds. 

Easy to play, hard to master!

[previewyoutube=m8xQS2oK8Cc;full][/previewyoutube]

Since this is an early access release, you can share your ideas how to improve the game on our official Discord server. We are always happy to answer any questions and help you if necessary! 

- Sobaka Studio
